rules.description: Verify all active StatVars meet non-tautological freshness boundaries (>= 2022 for 2022 population projections with 3 StatVars, >= 2007 for 2007 census breakdowns, >= 2011 with >= 144 StatVars at >= 2014 for DHS 2014, and >= 2011 for demographics and annual population series).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2014' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS svs_ge_2014 FROM stats
params.condition: CASE WHEN total_svs = 3 AND StatVar IN ('Count_Person', 'Count_Person_Female', 'Count_Person_Male') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2022' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person_(Rural|Urban)_(Female|Male)$') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2007' WHEN total_svs > 100 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2011' AND svs_ge_2014 >= 144 ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2011' END AND total_svs > 0
